title: 028 - Contact Preference
prompt: Fix the bug so the program pick the first non-empty contact option and print email and prints exactly `email`. Keep the sample data and do not add extra output.
brokenCode:
<?php

function contactPreference(string $text, string $query): bool
{
    return str_contains($text, strtolower($query));
}
solutionCode:
<?php

function contactPreference(string $text, string $query): bool
{
    return str_contains(strtolower($text), strtolower($query));
}
hint: The final fallback should still be used if earlier options are empty.
explanation: The broken code stops before checking the final fallback. Evaluating all options in order fixes it.
